title: The Market Caravan
text: A caravan camps in the Commons that no gate-ward saw arrive. Its traders wear veils even to eat, and their camels do not blink. They sell things nobody here has seen: salt from the bottom of a dead sea, glass that remembers, lamp oil that burns black.

options.label: Buy rare materials from the veiled traders (40 Gold).

outcomes.text: Strange stuff, carefully wrapped. Nobody remembers the traders' faces, only their hands.
The caravan is gone by morning. So are its wheel ruts, and the camels' tracks, and the memory of their faces.
